previous_assumption: The requirement detail page was effectively finished -- built for the Renter, and any Rental Company reaching it would just be an access-control gap to close by granting the same view
correction: The existing responses table lists every OTHER Rental Company's name and indicative rate on a Renter's requirement -- showing that unmodified to a Rental Company viewer would be a real cross-tenant information leak, not just a permissions oversight. A Rental Company viewer now gets a branched render entirely: fetches via getRequirementForDiscovery (rfq.respond) instead of the Renter-scoped getRequirement, and sees only a "Your response" card, never the other-parties table.
